title: Refuse-if-token-missing guard rejects submit with 400 before any downstream handler runs
asA: shelf consumer whose Worker rejects cheap missing-token submit attempts at the earliest possible boundary
iWant: a source-tree scan to enumerate every elicited surface and confirm each carries a token-required guard, and a live missing-token submit to be refused with 400 with no downstream side-effect
soThat: no downstream handler ever executes against a missing-token submit

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Node probe guard-shape-scan enumerates every elicited surface in the pack fixture source and asserts each is registered under the token-required guard. A live POST to /api/submit without a Cf-Turnstile-Response field is rejected with 400 and refusal body carries error-code turnstile.token-missing; no downstream handler side-effect is observable.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with every elicited surface registered under the token-required guard
acceptanceCriteria.when: a submit reaches /api/submit without a Cf-Turnstile-Response value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the guard rejects with 400 with an error-code body and no downstream handler runs
